C:P1.1.text: Aerospace Avionics, Flight Displays & Engineering | Innovative Aerosystems

C:P1.2.text: Avionics, flat panel displays, flight computers, and engineering for aerospace—quality, support, and in-house manufacturing.

C:P1.3.text: Tailored Avionics. Versatile Engineering. Manufactured In-House.

C:P1.4.text: Innovative Aerosystems designs, engineers, manufactures, certifies, and supports advanced avionics solutions for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. From integrated flight decks and autopilots to autothrottles, flight management systems, mission computers, air data systems, displays, engine instrumentation, and navigation technologies, our scalable solutions are engineered to meet the unique requirements of every platform.

C:P1.5.text: As one of the few U.S.-based avionics manufacturers with vertically integrated engineering and production, we control every stage of development—from concept and certification to manufacturing and lifecycle support. This enables us to deliver tailored, mission-ready solutions with the quality, reliability, and responsiveness our customers depend on. Whether modernizing legacy aircraft or developing next-generation capabilities, Innovative Aerosystems provides the expertise, flexibility, and innovation to keep fleets flying safely, efficiently, and ready for the future.

C:P2.1.text: About Innovative Aerosystems: USA-Made Avionics, Cockpit Solutions & Flight Deck Upgrades

C:P2.2.text: Innovative Aerosystems delivers certified avionics, retrofit solutions, and cockpit systems—engineered in the USA.

C:P2.3.text: Tailored, Versatile, and Made in the USA.

C:P2.4.text: At Innovative Aerosystems, we deliver custom avionics systems designed for your specific aircraft requirements—whether you’re upgrading a legacy platform or outfitting new production. From our FAA-certified flat panel flight decks to our award-winning ThrustSense® Autothrottle, our systems are engineered for performance, precision, and agility—delivering modern solutions for today’s demanding flight environments. Every product we design is engineered, certified, and manufactured at our in-house facility in Exton, Pennsylvania.

C:P2.5.text: Hundreds of aircraft are flying Innovative Aerosystems avionics, we specialize in retrofitting commercial, business, and military aircraft with advanced, value-driven solutions that reduce downtime and improve situational awareness. Our agile engineering team works directly with operators, MROs, and OEMs to deliver tailored solutions that meet certification standards while maintaining installation simplicity.

C:P2.6.text: If you’re looking for a proven avionics partner who can deliver certified cockpit upgrades, global positioning systems, or flight deck modernization with minimal disruption, Innovative Aerosystems is ready to support your next mission.
